narrative.details:
Welcome to the World of Warcraft!

As special thanks for purchasing the World of Warcraft Collector's Edition, turn in this gift voucher to Magga in the Valley of Trials.  You'll then be given a gift: a little companion to join you on your quest for adventure and glory.

Thanks again, and enjoy your stay in the World of Warcraft!
narrative.objectives: Bring the Valley of Trials Gift Voucher to Magga.
narrative.offerRewardText: You are indeed a special hero, adventurer. We welcome you to the world of Azeroth, and offer you one of these unique gifts!
narrative.requestItemsText:
Hello! It is a pleasure to meet you!

I see you have a special voucher. Give it to me and I will offer you something in exchange.
